Subject: Sparkline bootstrapping grant — application and ask

Hi Ben / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the intro at LaunchDay — excited to continue the conversation. We're a three-person team building a developer tool that extracts structured telemetry from messy app logs; we've been accepted into the Bootstrapping City accelerator and the program offers a handful of partner grants to cover inference costs during the 12-week pilot.

Ask: would Redwood be able to sponsor a $15k inference stipend (applied as free credits) for Sparkline and extend our 30-day trial to cover the 12-week program timeline? If possible we'd also like temporary private deployment credentials for one dedicated sandbox VPC so we can validate integration with our CI.

I'm attaching a short program summary and a recording of yesterday's demo. If you need more info, happy to share traction metrics and a cap table. We aim to start by 2026-11-08.

Thanks,
Eva Ramos
Founder, Sparkline
https://sparkline.ai

Hi Eva — great meeting you. Congrats on the accelerator acceptance.

Short answer: we can typically support a stipend + trial extension for accelerator partners, but there are a couple of standard checks (billing / security / SSO) and a milestone cadence we ask teams to agree to.

Can you confirm 3 things so we can route this:
1) Is the Sparkline account under your personal corporate entity (Sparkline Inc)?
2) Will seed/legal expect a vendor agreement or a simple grant letter?
3) Who from your engineering team should receive the VPC onboarding credentials (email)?

I'll start a conditional approval with legal/privileged credits and loop Vivek for commercial approval if the program start date is the week of 11/8. Monica will own the onboarding and MAP.

Next steps: once we have the answers above I can provision a credit hold and share a mutual action plan doc.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Hi Eva — I'm Monica, your Customer Success lead for onboarding. Nice to meet you.

We run accelerator stipends as milestone-driven credit activations to make sure the teams hit integration checkpoints and get production value. Proposed quick MAP:
- Week 0 (pre-launch): account verification, billing contact, add SSO if needed, access to sandbox VPC
- Week 2: end-to-end integration (embed + inference pipeline) — 25% credit release
- Week 6: load test + latency/cost baseline — 50% credit cumulative
- Week 10: production readiness checklist + playbook handoff — final 25% credit

If that cadence works we can draft the MAP and share a Doc where both sides initial. We do require an acceptance form from an authorised purchaser (simple one-page). Also note that private VPC credentials require a short security questionnaire and an IP allowlist.

Can you share: legal entity name, billing email, and the engineering contact for the sandbox?

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Hi Eva — welcome and congrats to the Sparkline team.

I've reviewed the program note and discussed commercial with Vivek. Redwood is happy to approve a $15,000 promotional stipend applied as platform credits, extended access through 2027-01-10 to align with your 12-week program, and sandbox VPC access for the duration of the pilot under the following conditions:

1) Execution of the Starter Grant Letter (I'll attach the DocuSign link below).
2) Completion of the short security questionnaire (we've flagged it as accelerated review for accelerator partners).
3) MAP agreed and initialed by both sides (Monica will own this).
4) Credits are milestone-driven per Monica's proposed cadence; unused credits do not convert to refunds.

Commercial notes: the stipend will be provisioned as a credit bucket tied to deal id SPK-2026-82731. We will provision a sandbox VPC (single AZ) with limited egress and an IP allowlist; data retention will follow our standard 30-day ephemeral KV cache policy unless you opt into longer retention under Private terms.

I've created the DocuSign for the Starter Grant Letter: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/SPK-82731-activate
And a MAP draft (internal-editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b3MAP-plan
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/182731|SPK-82731

I'll ask legal to fast-track the vendor acceptance form; Vivek, please advise if there are any commercial exceptions (discounts / SLA) beyond the stipend.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
